notes: Machine parts as data (ADR-646). One family per entry: the interface it is built by (one generator per interface in cadex_library_api.LibraryAPI.part), the fields every row carries with their units, where the numbers came from, what is approximate, and the rows keyed by part number. Adding a part number is a data change: a row here, checked by test_parts_data.py, and no code. Millimetres, newtons, N*mm, kg, kg*mm^2 and bar throughout.

provenance.source: HIWIN MG miniature linear guideway catalogue, MGNR rail table (W_R, H_R, D, h, d, P, E); cross-checked against an interchange listing (lily-bearing.com MGN12H/MGNR12R) on 2026-10-10.
approximate: The rail is its rectangular envelope with counterbored holes; the ball grooves are not modelled.
Hole positions start at end_distance_mm from the rail's datum end; a rail cut to another length is the user's choice.

fields.assembly_height_mm: mm (H, rail base to carriage top)
fields.clearance_mm: mm (H1, rail base to carriage underside)

provenance.source: HIWIN MG miniature linear guideway catalogue, MGN block table (H, H1, W, L, B, C, M); cross-checked on 2026-10-10 against an interchange listing, which gives L 47.6 mm for MGN12H with end seals where HIWIN's table gives 45.4.
approximate: The carriage is its envelope with the rail channel and four tapped holes; recirculation caps, seals and grease nipple are not modelled.
dynamic_load_n is the catalogue's basic dynamic load rating, kept as quoted.

provenance.source: GT2 (2GT) profile: 2.000 mm pitch, pitch line 0.254 mm outside the tooth tips (Gates PowerGrip GT2 design manual). Hub, flange and bore are the common 3D-printer pulley and idler (e.g. the 20T 5 mm bore 6 mm belt pulley and the F623-based 20T idler) as sold by many vendors.
approximate: Teeth are not modelled: the toothed band is a cylinder at the outside diameter. pitch_radius_mm is the tooth count's exact pitch circle.
Hub, flange and length vary a few tenths between vendors.

provenance.source: Gates PowerGrip GT2 2MGT: 2.000 mm pitch, 1.38 mm overall thickness, 0.254 mm pitch-line differential.
approximate: The belt is a smooth band of its overall thickness laid on the pitch circles; teeth are not modelled.
density is a glass-fibre-reinforced neoprene figure, not a measured one.

provenance.source: Tr8x8(P2) and Tr8x2 trapezoidal lead screws per DIN 103 (nominal diameter, pitch, starts); SFU1204 rolled ball screw per the common SFU/DIN 69051 series table (d 12, lead 4).
approximate: The screw is its nominal-diameter cylinder; threads are not modelled. lead_mm is what assembly.joint('screw', thread_pitch_mm=...) takes.
efficiency is a typical figure (lead screw ~0.3-0.4 dry, ball screw ~0.9), not a rating.

fields.flange_offset_mm: mm (flange's datum face from the nut's datum end)

provenance.source: T8 brass flange nut as sold for 3D printers (body 10.2 mm, flange 22 mm with four 3.5 mm holes on 16 mm); SFU1204 ball nut per the SFU series table (D 24, A 40, B 10, L 40, W 32, X 4.5, flats H 30).
approximate: Internal threads and ball recirculation are not modelled; the bore is the screw's nominal diameter.

provenance.source: Face, bolt pattern, pilot and shaft: NEMA ICS 16 frame sizes 17 and 23 (42.3 / 56.4 mm square, 31.0 / 47.14 mm bolt square, 22.0 / 38.1 mm pilot). Lengths, torques, inertias and masses: the vendors' datasheets for 17HS4401, StepperOnline 17HS19-2004S1, 23HS22-2804S and 23HS30-2804S.
approximate: The case is a square block with the pilot boss and a round shaft (the D flat is not modelled), corner chamfers omitted.
holding_torque_nmm is static holding torque, not running torque at speed: size a drive's torque_limit_nmm well under it.
rotor_inertia_kgmm2 is the datasheet's rotor inertia; give it to assembly.joint_dynamics(armature_kgmm2=...) on the motor's joint.

fields.tap: metric size for the end bores

provenance.source: 20-series 6 mm slot aluminium profile (Misumi HFS5-2020 / HFS5-2040, Bosch Rexroth 20x20 B-type and their V-slot equivalents): 20 mm module, 6.2 mm slot opening, 4.2 mm centre bore for an M5 tap, 1.8 mm slot lip.
approximate: The slot is a T: the 6.2 mm opening through the 1.8 mm lip, then an 8 mm undercut to 5 mm deep (the real slot is about 6 mm deep and its trapezoid undercut wider, reaching under diagonal webs a rectangle cannot keep); the V-groove is squared off and the core is solid.
density is the profile's quoted mass over the modelled section, so the mass is the vendor's.

provenance.source: 20-series M5 roll-in T-nut and 20x20x20 cast corner bracket as sold for 2020 profile.
approximate: The T-nut is a block with its thread's tap hole; the spring ball and the roll-in radius are not modelled.
The bracket is an L of two plates with one clearance hole each; the gusset is not modelled.

fields.dead_length_mm: mm (pin to pin at zero stroke, minus nothing)

provenance.source: Pneumatic: ISO 6432 (bore 16/20/25, rods 6/8/10) and ISO 15552 (bore 32/40, rods 12/16) round and profile cylinders, 10 bar maximum, 6 bar working. Hydraulic: ISO 6020-2 160 bar series (bore 25 rod 12, bore 40 rod 18, bore 50 rod 22). Bore, rod and pressure are the standards'.
approximate: dead_length_mm (retracted pin centres less the stroke), barrel_od_mm, pin_dia_mm and clevis_width_mm are typical of the catalogue families, not one maker's drawing.
The barrel and rod are plain cylinders and the clevises plain eyes; ports, cushions and tie rods are not modelled.
Drive it with assembly.actuator(joint, kind='cylinder', bore_mm=..., rod_mm=..., pressure_bar=working_pressure_bar, ...).

provenance.source: Clamp diameters and collet sizes of the common router spindles: the 52 mm 300-500 W DC ER11 spindle, the 65 mm 800 W ER11 spindle and the 80 mm 1.5 kW 24 000 rpm water-cooled ER16 spindle (GDZ80-1.5). ER collet capacities per DIN 6499 (ER11 7 mm, ER16 10 mm).
approximate: body_length_mm, nose dimensions and mass are typical of the families, not one maker's drawing; the cooling ports and cable gland are not modelled.

provenance.source: Light-duty plate swivel casters in the common 50 mm (2 in) and 75 mm (3 in) wheel sizes; plate and hole pattern of the usual 60x45 / 67x67 mm top plates.
approximate: A generic catalogue caster, not one maker's part: the yoke is two plates and an axle, the swivel bearing a disc; overall_height_mm and swivel_offset_mm are typical.

provenance.source: Tyre size codes, which are the dimensions: 13x5.00-6 is a 13 in (330 mm) outer diameter, 5.00 in (127 mm) section, 6 in (152 mm) rim; 16x6.50-8 and 20x10.00-8 likewise; 4.10/3.50-4 is a 4.10 in section on a 4 in rim, about 260 mm outside.
approximate: The tyre is a cylinder with its shoulders rounded by the section; tread is not modelled.
hub_length_mm, hub_dia_mm, bore_mm and mass_kg are typical of a steel-rim wheel with a plain bearing hub.

provenance.source: Closed-and-ground music-wire compression springs (EN 10270-1 SH, G = 81 500 MPa) in common stock sizes; the rate is computed, not quoted: k = G d^4 / (8 D^3 n), D the mean diameter.
approximate: The spring is a tube of its outer and inner diameters at free length; the coil is not modelled. spec carries rate_n_per_mm for assembly.joint_dynamics/actuator stiffness, solid_length_mm and the deflection to solid.
